description: List quarterly rocks for the authenticated organization. Filter by quarter (e.g. '2026-Q2') or owner_external_id. Each rock carries status: on_track, off_track, completed or archived. Read status, not the on_track flag: a completed rock can still carry on_track false from before it was finished. Archived rocks are left out unless include_archived is true.

include_archived.description: Also return archived rocks. Default false.

on_track.description: Only open rocks that are on track (true) or off track (false); completed and archived rocks are excluded

name: list_rocks
